Common questions

Simple answers before you start.

Can we begin with a project and move to a monthly plan later?+

Yes. This is often the best route. We complete a defined website, automation, integration or training project, then recommend a monthly partnership only where ongoing improvement would create value.

Do monthly plans require a long contract?+

Founding Partner engagements begin with an initial three-month period. After that, plans run month to month and can end with 30 days' written notice unless your proposal states another agreed arrangement.

Will we receive a proposal before work begins?+

Yes. Your proposal states the outcome, scope, responsibilities, exclusions, timeline, investment, monthly capacity where relevant and third-party costs.

Who owns our accounts and work?+

Your business retains ownership of its domains, platform accounts, source files and data. Dakyworld receives only the access needed to complete agreed work.
